assessment: The November 15, 2026 frozen provider snapshots represent a verified, extended superset of the November 14, 2026 snapshot. Across all 2,478 shared NSE observations and all 2,466 shared Yahoo observations, closing prices match with 100.0% precision (0 price discrepancies under 1e-4 tolerance).
reason: Date set differences (+10 pre-start dates from 2016-11-01 to 2016-11-15 and endpoint resolution on 2016-11-16) explain row count divergence, while underlying pricing data is completely preserved without drift.
limitations: Historical raw full OHLCV (open, high, low, volume) from the November 14 retrieval was not saved as separate CSV files; equivalence is verified on close prices preserved in price_reconciliation.csv.

inconsistencies_recorded.issue: Pre-start date set expansion not highlighted in earlier brief summaries
inconsistencies_recorded.detail: Earlier documentation referenced the shift from 2,465 to 2,476 matched dates primarily focusing on 2016-11-16, without explicitly explaining that the requested start date of 2016-11-01 added 10 dual-source trading sessions prior to 2016-11-16.
